newsitem.title: USA: Colonial to buy South Florida Banking Corp.
newsitem.headline: Colonial to buy South Florida Banking Corp.

text.p: Colonial BancGroup Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to acquire South Florida Banking Corp for stock.
Colonial said it will exchange 1.6089 shares of its stock and options for each share of South Florida's stock and options, in a transaction to be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests.

A spokesman for South Florida said the total value of the deal will be about $50 million. He added that subject to a definitive agreement, regulatory and shareholder approval, the transaction is expected to close in late 1997.
South Florida has assets of $250 million and twelve branches in southwest Florida.
Colonial BancGroup, based in Montgomery, has about $6 billion in assets and operates 181 full service offices in Alabama, Florida, Georgia and Tennessee.
